categories.name: Goal and Reasoning Failure
categories.description: The agent misunderstands the task, constraints, plan, or evidence.

categories.name: Tool Selection Failure
categories.description: The agent chooses the wrong tool, omits a required tool, invokes an unsupported capability, or sequences tools incorrectly.

categories.name: Tool Execution Failure
categories.description: The agent invokes a tool incorrectly or handles tool runtime conditions poorly.

categories.name: Data and Observation Failure
categories.description: The agent uses stale, missing, incorrect, conflicting, misread, or unverified data.

categories.name: Context and Memory Failure
categories.description: The agent loses relevant context, uses irrelevant context, pollutes memory, or confuses instruction priority.

categories.name: State and Concurrency Failure
categories.description: The agent acts on state that changed, is only partially updated, or cannot be verified.

categories.name: Authorization and Authority Failure
categories.description: The agent lacks authorization, exceeds scope, bypasses approval, or trusts the wrong authority source.

categories.name: Security and Adversarial Failure
categories.description: The agent is compromised or manipulated by attacks against prompts, tools, plugins, data, credentials, memory, or inter-agent trust.

categories.name: Recovery and Retry Failure
categories.description: The agent recovers unsafely, retries without verification, loops excessively, rolls back incorrectly, or aborts too early.

categories.name: Side-Effect Failure
categories.description: The agent creates the wrong external effect, duplicates an action, affects the wrong target, or increases blast radius.

categories.name: Autonomy and Human-Handoff Failure
categories.description: The agent fails to ask, escalate, abort, respect rejection, or correctly interpret human instruction.
